scope: All mode, selection, malformed-library recovery and pending-accent plans on AT84, BIOS and DOS input. XT83 completion remains a separate gate.
hardware_exclusions: Left Ctrl+Alt replaces unavailable right Alt. Separate right Ctrl and ISO scan-86 key are excluded.
Legacy keypad navigation restores Num Lock and returns AL=00; literal CP775 E0 is preserved.
oracle: Independent retained keyboard expectations and existing QEMU lifecycle plans, adapted only for physical legacy keys. Every cached guest probe and phase action is rebuilt and compared with the completed image during retention.

runs.completion_scope: Complete AT matrix assembled from unchanged passing cases of the original run and corrected German BIOS/DOS cases. Original terminal failure is retained; this does not claim one uninterrupted successful invocation.

repair_provenance.source_explanation: KEYBI9C K17F clears Caps on Shift only for enhanced or PC_LAP keyboards. Legacy AT/XT requires a physical Caps Lock toggle.

retention_validation: Current phase plans, physical steps, actions and compiled cached probes exactly reproduce those used in the retained completed images.
